newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish 1996 automotive exports rise by 10.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Turkish 1996 automotive exports rise by 10.5 pct.

text.p: Turkish automotive exports rose by 10.5 percent in 1996 to $1.314 million, from $1.189 million a year ago, according to figures released by the Turkish vehicle exporters union on Monday.

Automotive exports rose by 11.2 percent to $516.91 million last year from $464.89 million in 1995 while allied industry exports rose to $797.12 million from 1995's $724.25 million, an increase of 10 percent.
Passenger cars took up the biggest share of vehicle exports, though exports of these fell by six percent in 1996 to $256.03 million from $272.33 million in the previous year.
Exports of buses and minibuses meanwhile jumped by 68 percent to $218.75 million in 1996 from $130.20 million in 1995.
